summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K noting, under UK Listing Rule 6.4.9R(2), that independent Non-Executive Director Wendy Becker CBE was appointed a Non-Executive Director of Tesco PLC effective 1 November 2026. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed; Company Secretary V A Whyte signed the notice dated 8 October 2026. This is an ordinary director-disclosure notification, not a special situation, with no deal mechanics or regulatory clock; watch only for any further non-executive appointments or potential time-commitment concerns under UK governance rules.
